title: kbmon's host, sprint and log panels read the ops rows once per snapshot
goal: one kbmon snapshot reads bl_stall.ops_rows at most once for the host, sprint and log panels together, so the three do not each re-read all committed ops rows within the panel timeout

run:
import os,sys,tempfile
os.environ.update(CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=tempfile.mkdtemp(),CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd())
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_base,bl_stall,pathlib
n=[0];o=bl_stall.ops_rows
def f(*a,**k):
    n[0]+=1;return o(*a,**k)
bl_stall.ops_rows=f
mon_base.snapshot(mon_base.Ctx(root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve(),store=None,url=None,key_file=None),['host','sprint','log'],30)
print('ops_rows calls',n[0]);sys.exit(0 if n[0]<=1 else 1)

notes: SP-v4yih547 review: about 145k ops rows, 0.8 s per read; --json took 6.0 s for host, sprint and log and 7.7 s for kb against the 10 s default timeout on this host.
